procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (banner 'Federal General Election 2026' on the table pages -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/yalobusha/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (11/11 on table A, 4/4 on table B).
structure_note: Five-page shape: p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's TWELVE precincts (11 columns, then Three Sylva Rena + TOTAL) carrying Senate, US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District, CoA 1 Positions 1-2, and Chancery 3 Place 1; p4+p5 = table B over the same column split carrying Chancery 3 Places 2-3, Circuit 17 Places 1-2, and two local school-board sections. The banner prints 'Federal General Election 2026' rather than 'General Election 2026'. Races: U.S. Senate (Colom/Hyde-Smith/Pinkins, ballot order DEM-REP-IND); US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller REP FIRST, then Bennie G. Thompson DEM, then Bennie Foster IND -- the House 2 roster, names identical, its ballot order runs Republican-first); Court Of Appeals 01-District 1 Position 1 (Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr., John Weddle) and Position 2 (Donna M. Barnes) -- the same CoA 1 roster, names identical; Chancery Court 3-Chancery District 3 Place 1 (Ginger M. Miller, Jay Westfaul), Place 2 (Sabrina D. Howell), Place 3 (Mitchell M. Lundy Jr.) -- the FULL Chancery 3 three-place roster, names identical (EIGHTH county); Circuit Court 17-Circuit District 17 Place 1 (Smith Murphey V) and Place 2 (James 'Jimmy' McClure) -- identical to Tate/Panola. Printed totals: Colom 2389, Hyde-Smith 2297, Pinkins 128, Eller 2334, Thompson 2349, Foster 114, Hopson 2108, Weddle 2121, Barnes 3957, Miller 2491, Westfaul 1761, Howell 3946, Lundy 3994, Murphey 3948, McClure 3945.
operator_rows_note: All 15 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3 cells + the p3 printed TOTAL, table-B rows carry p4+p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. The X-celled school-board rows are local and contribute no parse rows.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twelve precinct headers print complete (Beat One North, Beat One South, Beat Two Water Valley, Five Coffeeville, Five Scobey, Five Tillatoba, Four Coffeeville, Four Oakland, Scuna - Vann's Mill North, Scuna - Vann's Mill South, Three North West, Three Sylva Rena -- the sheet's own beat/numbered forms kept verbatim, including the 'Scuna - Vann's Mill North/South' split).
local_note: p4 carries two local sections after Circuit 17 Place 2 (their tails on p5): 'SCHOOL BOARD 5 COFFEEVILLE-coffeeville school board 5' (Mitchell Steen, X-celled outside Beat One South/Beat Two Water Valley/Five Coffeeville/Four Coffeeville) and 'SCHOOL BOARD 5 WATER VALLEY-Water Valley School Board District 5' (Tonya Eubanks) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows. Chancery 3's printed Places are 1, 2 and 3; Circuit 17's printed Places are 1 and 2 (matching the other Circuit 17 counties).
